newsitem.title: USA: Equitable up on strong Q4, improved sales.
newsitem.headline: Equitable up on strong Q4, improved sales.

text.p: Shares of Equitable Cos Inc rose more than six percent in active trading after the New York life insurer posted surprisingly strong fourth quarter earnings and showed improved life and annuity sales.
Equitable reported fourth quarter operating earnings after the stock market closed on Tuesday of $0.64 a share compared with analysts' First Call consensus estimate of $0.50.
Equitable shares rose 1-7/8, or 6.5 percent to 30-5/8 at midday.
Schroder Wertheim analyst Andrew Kligerman said he was encouraged by fourth quarter gains in life and annuity sales.
"It could be viewed as Equitable beginning to turn the corner in terms of its sales momentum," he said.

Equitable said after-tax operating earnings from its insurance and annuity operations rose 66 percent to $71.2 million in the fourth quarter, excluding after-tax investment gains, restructuring charges and reserve strengthening.
Future earnings also will be helped by an accounting change and by charges taken in the fourth quarter to strengthen primarily disabilty income reserves.

The possible sale of its Equitable Real Estate Investment Management Inc also may generate additional capital that the company than could use to buy back stock or make an acquisition in the life insurance business, Kligerman said.
